steps.comment: The counter branch answers first and opens the shop second, so the choice has to be followed through one message window. It cannot be an `advance`: Shop Processing leaves $gameMap.isEventRunning() true for as long as the shop is up, so `advance` would go on pressing confirm inside Scene_Shop and start buying things.
